top_signals.title: Italy Convenes Oil Refiners as it Seeks to Boost Fuel Output
top_signals.summary: The Italian government will meet its oil refining industry next month to discuss a boost in production as concern grows that surging prices for diesel and other fuels could stoke inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Lead Gains as Oil Falls; Yen Climbs: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The final stretch of a jittery week on Wall Street saw a rebound in stocks as oil prices fell, easing a selloff in bonds that had roiled financial markets around the world.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
